title: Brazilian Ciabatta Grill
description: A silky, yeasted Brazilian-inspired ciabatta dish perfect for midnight cravings, made using a grill and satvik-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine 1 cup of warm water and 1 teaspoon of yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes.

Add 1 1/2 cups of ciabatta bread, 1 cup of mozzarella cheese, 1/4 cup of fresh oregano, 3 cloves of garlic, 1/4 cup of fresh basil, 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 teaspoon of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper to the bowl. Mix well.
Add 2 large eggs to the bowl and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes.
Place the dough on a baking sheet and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the balls on the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve the ciabatta grill hot, garnished with fresh oregano and basil.
